<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915462_theRebbe_206" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915462_theRebbe_206__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains how charity scattered among the nations, through our service in exile, accumulates to hasten the physical redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is the matter of charity etc. that was scattered among the nations,</t>
    <t s="1">that through our deeds and service during the time of exile</t>
    <t s="2">(in the three lines of Torah, service, and acts of kindness, and particularly in the spreading of the wellsprings outward)</t>
    <t s="3">that [occur] each and every day,</t>
    <t s="4">behold, in addition to that which each and every day</t>
    <t s="5">(when we are still in exile)</t>
    <t s="6">a spiritual redemption is accomplished</t>
    <t s="7">(as if He redeemed me),</t>
    <t s="8">behold, each and every action among the aforementioned combines into a great account of charity</t>
    <t s="9">that brings closer the redemption</t>
    <t s="10">in its simple physical sense,</t>
    <t s="11">so that then "Jerusalem will dwell as unwalled cities" also physically,</t>
    <t s="12">with the coming of Moshiach our righteous one,</t>
    <t s="13">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
